# iccatSALB

`iccatSALB` is an R package supporting the Management Strategy
Evaluation (MSE) for South Atlantic albacore tuna, developed for the
International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT).
It provides the operating models, management procedures, performance
metrics, and all related data and code used to evaluate the candidate
management procedures against a range of plausible operating models for
the stock and fishery.

See the [project homepage](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/) for
an overview of the MSE materials, and the [Trial Specifications
Document](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/tsd/) for full details
of the operating models, management procedures, and performance metrics
used in the MSE.

## Installation

You can install the `iccatSALB` package from its [GitHub
repository](https://github.com/Blue-Matter/iccatSALB) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Blue-Matter/iccatSALB")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Build_OM_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Build_OM_Grid.md)
  : Build a reference operating model grid specification
- [`Downweight_Index()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Downweight_Index.md)
  : Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3
  control file
- [`Downweight_Index_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Downweight_Index_Grid.md)
  : Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey
  index
- [`Import_OM_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Import_OM_Grid.md)
  : Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects
- [`Modify_Growth_M()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Modify_Growth_M.md)
  : Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control
  file
- [`Prepare_OM_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Prepare_OM_Grid.md)
  : Prepare SS3 run directories for an operating model grid
- [`Run_SS3_Grid()`](https://iccatsalb.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Run_SS3_Grid.md)
  : Run SS3 across a set of model directories in parallel
